title: Nothing in the game states up front how many hollows need burning for the Regent's writ (2) versus the Keepers' stair (3 rested) or the Free Companies' word — I only learned '2 burned' from one throwaway herald line at turn 143 and had to remember it unaided for the rest of the run.
